According to the documentation:
> When the Add holdings/items of related records option is selected and in order for it to be effective, the "Related Records Enrichment" table must have at least one entry and of Relation Type; Contains.

This means that we don't have to worry about filtering out certain added 852/876 fields.

The logic for requests needs to stay the same, since the host holdings in the published record don't show which MMS ID the holding relates to. So we wouldn't be able to access the requests route using the holdings from publishing.

Current `raw` for the sample record above: https://catalog.princeton.edu/catalog/998973453506421/raw
